Sign in to Azure DevOps to start exploring your pipelines.
[Sign in with Microsoft](command:pipelinesexplorer.signInWithMicrosoft)
[Sign in with Personal Access Token](command:pipelinesexplorer.signInWithPat)

Use Microsoft sign-in for organizations connected to Microsoft Entra ID. Use a PAT for legacy or fine-grained scenarios.
